boundary_evidence: contiguous run 0x020b8f50..0x020bbe60, 24 functions, all byte-matched from the one unit source. A sub-range of build/tu_map.json's unattributed ov007 unit 0x020b72a0..0x020cc028 (397 functions), which the map cannot cut: no ROM RTTI, vtable or static initializer falls in it.

data window: the three bss words 0x02104b98..0x02104ba4 (the scene record, the sprite record and the settle counter) are referenced by every function in the run, by func_ov007_020bbe60 and by nothing else in the overlay.

module shape: one scene. func_ov007_020b9880 / 020b9770 build and free both records; the states[0] machine (func_ov007_020b9640) drives the intro, drawing and edit phases through the functions above it; the five getters at the bottom read the records for callers outside the run.

start edge (high): func_ov007_020b8ec0 touches no data and is called only from the module whose bss block ends at 0x02104b98. End edge (medium): func_ov007_020bbe60 is the only other reader of the scene record data_ov007_02104ba0, but it is the intact object ov007/AnimationPathSets, which owns the portrait stroke tables (.rodata 0x020cdb34..0x020cdb4c, .data 0x020d7e68..0x020d7ec8). One TU cannot own both sets of tables: .rodata 0x020d7584..0x020d7db8 holds the tables read privately by unit020b3edc through func_ov007_020c241c in text order, and the ones this unit's functions read (0x020d7b54..0x020d7c28) lie between those read by unit020b797c and by func_ov007_020bd1c0. The stroke counts at 0x020cdb34 instead lie inside the portrait coordinate block 0x020ccca4..0x020d7584, which follows the .rodata unit020b2764's functions read. Folding the function in would either return its 120 native data bytes to ROM imports or put into one TU tables that are not contiguous with the ones this unit's functions read, so it stays out (screened 2026-10-30).
notes: Text only: the bss words stay ROM-owned and are reached by extern, as the one-function sources did.

Folded from 24 sources. They declared 17 partial views of the scene record (14 of them named Ov007PickerScene), 10 of the picker and 7 of the sprite record, and reached the records through char *, int * and u8 [] spellings; the unit has one Ov007PickerScene (0x4c), one Ov007Picker (the 0xd0 picker's named slots) and one Ov007PickerSprites (0x14).

func_ov007_020bb4b0's source needed #pragma opt_propagation off and func_ov007_020b9880's #pragma opt_strength_reduction off; six other functions break under the first. Neither pragma is needed: func_ov007_020bb4b0 matches without it once its third block declares amp before dir2, and func_ov007_020b9880 matches as is.
Where the sources disagreed on a callee's extern, the unit uses one spelling some source already used and casts at the call site.
